May 16, 2023
Claim opened for a collision in a parking lot. The insured driver is named on the policy, and the claimant is
represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the lawyer's office.
May 30, 2023
Police report places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the crash. Photos taken at the scene show the damage,
and the vehicle damage is consistent with the impact described. No independent witness saw the collision itself.
June 18, 2023
Claimant reports a concussion from the impact. The injury fits the kind and force of a crash like this. No earlier injury
to the same body area is knwon from prior records.
July 28, 2023
Initial account from the claimant is recorded and runs consistent with the police report. Some small details were
added in a later conversation, but the core account has not changed.
August 2, 2023
A neighbor mentioned seeing the car with damage several weeks before the claimed loss date. This has not been
confirmed, and I have asked for any repair or prior-damage records on the vehicle. None are known to exist so far.
August 26, 2023
Treatment followed a usual course, with follow-up visits tapering off as the claimnat improved. The medical notes
match the timeline of the reported symptoms.
September 25, 2023
Claim file reviewed with the supervisor. Liability and injury facts are being evaluated in light of the neighbor's
comment, and the open item is obtaining any prior repair history for the vehicle before a decision is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
